environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. The Lambda execution role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:*) on the UserProfiles table with no IAM condition keys. API Gateway has CORS configured with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. No SameSite cookie attribute enforcement. The API Gateway has no custom authorizer beyond the Lambda's internal session validation. Cookie-based authentication flows through API Gateway without any additional request validation.
